defects.evidence: Line 195 narrows AC-1.1 to "every command in sections 3.1-3.2 whose phase is P1 or earlier, except `load` (M3)", and line 159 says the flag is accepted by "each command in the Commands column"; P2-P4 commands and pr-submit are no longer asserted in P1. Later phases do not assert the section explicitly (AC-2.1 is per gate), a minor gap.

Line 73 now says the brief includes --unattended "(from the phase that adds it to that command, section 6; Phase 0 briefs omit it)" and line 159 says "later phases add it to their own commands", so gated P2/P4 commands do not accept the flag before their gates convert.

Line 112 says load "writes no contract and is exempt from WC-4, AC-1.1 and AC-1.2 [M3]", line 159 says "no section or flag", and line 195 excludes it; line 76 still says every changed command gains the section, a small residual.

Line 84 gives brainstorm "Add the `## Unattended mode` section only (P1)", line 87 gives init-lite the contract and section in P1, and line 159 lists "brainstorm (section only) and init-lite (contract and section)", consistent with line 79 and AC-1.1.

Line 79 now says the worker reports the named file "until the phase in the last column adds the contract", so tdd, troubleshoot, release-split and reflect get their contract in their P2 phase; the P2 scope cell (line 160) does not say so explicitly.

Line 62 now defines the file-valued case as "the directory that holds that file", so a path exists, but two workers whose output files share a folder write the same return-contract.yaml (WC-11 clause of is_fixed_when not met); this is the I01 pattern.
Line 83 changes the adversarial fix to "Fix the contract path to `<output>/return-contract.yaml`, the WC-4 path (P1)", matching WC-4, the section intro and AC-1.4 (line 198).

Line 92 adds "`--output <dir>`: the contract is also written at `<dir>/return-contract.yaml` (the WC-4 path), including for pre-creation STOPs", and AC-1.4 (line 198) checks the contract is written "at `<dir>/return-contract.yaml` for pre-creation STOPs". P0 report path for the generated id is still loose.

Lines 85-86 give cleanup-audit "`.claude-audit/return-contract.yaml`" and index-repo a contract "beside `PROJECT_INDEX.md`", and AC-1.2 (line 196) uses the fixed path for them; troubleshoot (line 91) still has no output flag and no stated contract path.
